verses.1: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.
verses.2: Now the earth was formless and empty, darkness was over the surface of the deep, and the Spirit of God was hovering over the waters.
verses.3: And God said, "Let there be light," and there was light.
verses.4: God saw that the light was good, and he separated the light from the darkness.
verses.5: God called the light "day," and the darkness he called "night." And there was evening, and there was morning-the first day.
verses.6: And God said, "Let there be an expanse between the waters to separate water from water."
